config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config._comment_table: Only the outbox. The domain tables are never streamed: CDC straight off them would make the internal schema the public event contract (D-16).
config._comment_slot: One replication slot per connector. Postgres needs wal_level=logical and a slot budget that covers it.
config.slot.name: eauction_admin_outbox
config.publication.name: eauction_admin_outbox_pub
config._comment_router: The EventRouter SMT reads the default column names, which is why the table uses them verbatim.
config._comment_topics: aggregatetype selects the destination. Each destination has its own aggregate type so auctions.sealed, which carries the reserve price, is a separate topic with its own ACL (D-06).
